Team —

TritonWorks is at the final procurement stage and needs a committed dedicated pool for their production launch. They sent an internal MA which I attached (TritonWorks_MA-plan_v2.pdf). Key asks:

- Start window: January 15, 2027 (they want a two-week onboarding window starting then).
- Expected steady throughput: equivalent to ~24 A100s for model generation (peak concurrency ~80 req/s), but they asked to explore a H100 mix to hit latency SLOs.
- Initial commit: 12 H100 or equivalent (they will pay for reserved capacity; pricing under negotiation).
- Desired hold period: provisional soft-hold for 60 days while they finish procurement paperwork.

Please run an internal availability check against capacity for us-west-2 and propose a right-sizing plan (node mapping, suggested fallback flavors, and how much we can safely provision without blocking other commitments). If we can't grant a full 60d hold, propose a staged plan (e.g., 30d hold on 12 H100 + 15d extension request). Include any operational caveats (thermal throttling windows, maintenance blackout dates) and an ops ticket template we can present to legal/procurement for the hold.

I also need an estimate for whether we can meet TritonWorks' latency goal if we downsize to 16 A100 + quantized model path (they've signaled flexibility on model precision to reduce GPU footprint).

I've included SLA-exception-request.docx they may push for an SLA tweak; loop in product if needed.

Next actions:
- Laura/aditya: inventory and suggestion by EOD today.
- Hannah: sign-off expectations for >30d holds.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

- Region: us-west-2 has available capacity in two pools that can satisfy this request without preempting existing Reserved commitments. We can map a staged allocation:
  - Immediate provisional hold: 12 H100 equivalents (we have 8 physical H100 nodes free + capacity to convert 8 A100 nodes via planned re-quantization for lower precision inference to reach an H100-equivalent footprint).
  - If TritonWorks accepts mixed fleet: we propose 8 H100 + 10 A100 (quantized) as the conservative starting allocation. That meets estimated latency target with model quantization + batching profiles.

- Hold timing: Ops can create a 30-day provisional hold right now. For the requested 60 days, we'd need senior ops approval and a contingency plan for ramping down if other committed deals surface.

Operational caveats:
- Maintenance window: cluster-usw2-rack7 has scheduled kernel updates Dec 3–4; we can avoid scheduling migration then.
- Thermal constraints: sustained throughput above the projected steady state will trigger throttling on 3 nodes in rack7; recommend spreading across racks 5 and 8.

Attachments: capacity-matrix-20261115.csv (inventory + node map), short node mapping notes in the CSV.

If Ops is comfortable, I'll open a provisional hold ticket and mark it for Hannah's approval for extension beyond 30 days.
